messages:
Marta (PM): Heads-up — BigCorp asked for per-tenant benchmark gating + staged fallback for model rotations. They want: per-tenant pin, nightly benchmark on their probe set, and automatic fallback when quality drops > 5% vs baseline. Want scope for Q3 sprint.

Jia (Eng): Can you clarify the SLOs we should enforce? is 5% relative on accuracy the only gate or also latency/cost?

Marta (PM): Good q. Customer cares about accuracy first, but they also flagged p99 latency spikes. Proposed gates: (1) quality delta <= 5% (task score), (2) p99 latency not worse than +50ms, (3) cost delta < 15%. If any fail -> fallback to pinned variant.

Samir (ML): For "task score" we need a stable metric per customer. Recommend letting them upload a small labeled probe set (50–200 examples) and we compute F1 / exact-match / BLEU depending on task. Use weighted aggregate so we can support multi-task customers.

Oliver (SRE): Storage + encryption notes: per-tenant probes must be encrypted-at-rest, access audited. Also schedule: nightly runs could spike infra if many tenants opt-in. Need a queuing + rate-limit plan.

Jia (Eng): Rough config prototype (UI + API) — YAML sketch: 
```
tenant_id: bigcorp-123
pin: model-neo-6-v2
bench_config:
  probe_source: s3://tenant-probes/bigcorp-123/probe.json
  metrics:
    - name: task_f1
      threshold_delta_pct: 5
    - name: p99_latency_ms
      threshold_abs: 50
  cadence: nightly
fallback: model-neo-6-v1
notify: [marta@redwood, eng-oncall]
```
This plugs into the existing catalog + rollout infra.

Marta (PM): Nice. Need to confirm data retention and privacy language for customers to upload probes. Legal will want a checkbox in the console.

Samir (ML): We should reuse Optimize's evaluation harness so we can run the same eval code that flags regressions during model onboarding. Minimal engineering: hook tenant probe -> eval runner -> metrics store -> gating service.

Oliver (SRE): Operational plan: +1 job queue worker pool dedicated to tenant-evals, autoscale with rate limit. If nightly backlog grows > 12h, demote cadence to 3x/week or run sampling. Also enforce per-tenant concurrency cap.

Marta (PM): Launch gates proposal (lean):
- Gate 0: Config + consent UI (legal signoff)
- Gate 1: Eval pipeline wired to catalog + auth + encryption
- Gate 2: Canary with 5 pilot tenants (including BigCorp) for 4 weeks
- Gate 3: GA if canary success and infra cost within expected bounds
(we can tighten thresholds later)

Jia (Eng): Dev estimate: infra + API + UI + auth ~4 dev-weeks; eval harness wiring ~2 dev-weeks; rollout + canary infra ~1 week ops work. Total ~7 dev-weeks + ops.

Oliver (SRE): Ops estimate: worker pool + autoscaling + monitoring dashboards ~2 weeks, plus runbook for fallback/alerts. We'll need a dedicated oncall window during canary.

Samir (ML): ML work: standardizing per-tenant metric templates + baseline computation ~1 week, implement aggregated alert logic ~1 week.

Marta (PM): Ok — decision: prioritize a minimal MVP that supports: per-tenant pin, probe upload, nightly eval against single task metric, and automatic fallback to pinned variant. Owners: Jia (eng), Samir (ml), Oliver (sre).

Jia (Eng): Assigning: I'll drive the API + UI. Will create an RFC PR with the YAML schema.

Samir (ML): I'll add templates to Optimize and draft the evaluation playbook for tenants.

Oliver (SRE): I'll scope autoscaling, retention rules, and the runbook.

Marta (PM): Action items before next sync (Thu):
- Jia: RFC PR with schema + rough API spec
- Samir: sample metric templates + baseline calc doc
- Oliver: infra cost estimate + retention/encryption plan
- Marta: Legal checklist for probe uploads + customer comm template

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: tenant-eval-worker pool scaled to 2 instances for testing.

Marta (PM): Thanks all — let's keep this lightweight for Q3 MVP. If we hit complexity, we'll split into two sprints (benching + rollout). Ping me on PRs. :thumbsup:
